newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks surge at close on pre-budget rally.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks surge at close on pre-budget rally.

text.p: Pakistani stocks finished sharply up on Monday as retail investors jumped in following foreign buying in select blue chips ahead of Friday's 1997/98 (July-June) budget, dealers said.
"Speculative retail investors are buying across the board following foreign investors who are picking low-priced blue chips," dealer Ali Asghar at Fortune Securities said.
The Karachi 100-share index rose 29.20 points, or 1.91 percent, to end at 1,559.97 at 0907 GMT. Bank of Punjab rose 2.10 rupees to 24.40 and PTCL 1.50 to 27. -- Ovais Subhani 9221-5685192
